issues.text: permDenialCache's key doesn't include identity type, so anonymous and render-service identities share the same denial records.
issues.zh: permDenialCache 的 key 不含 identity type，anonymous 與 render service 共用同一組拒絕紀錄

issues.text: The denial cache's key space is determined by the requester's name/folder with no bound.
issues.zh: denial cache 的 key 空間由請求端的 name/folder 決定，沒有任何上限

issues.text: The new deny test would still pass even with permDenialCache removed; it doesn't actually test the short-circuit logic.
issues.zh: 新增的 deny 測試即使拿掉 permDenialCache 也會通過，沒有測到短路邏輯

issues.text: getCachedIdentityPermissions duplicates the identity-type switch, and cache-key construction is scattered across three places.
issues.zh: getCachedIdentityPermissions 複製了 identity type switch，快取 key 的組法散在三處

issues.text: After removing getUserPermissions' cache read, every Check that the cache can't directly allow does a full database query.
issues.zh: 拿掉 getUserPermissions 的讀快取後，每一次無法由快取直接放行的 Check 都會完整查一次資料庫

issues.text: The permissionCacheUsage metric's cache_hit label doesn't match what actually happened, and conflates two different caches.
issues.zh: permissionCacheUsage 的 cache_hit 標籤與實際發生的事不符，且混用了兩個不同的快取

issues.text: The denial cache key joins name and parent with an unescaped underscore, but Grafana UIDs allow underscores.
issues.zh: denial cache key 以未跳脫的底線串接 name 與 parent，而 Grafana UID 允許底線

issues.text: NoopCache doesn't need to be exported, its receiver name is a leftover from the old implementation, and it lacks a comment explaining why it's needed.
issues.zh: NoopCache 不必匯出，receiver 名稱是舊實作的殘留，且缺少說明為何需要它的註解

issues.text: TestService_getUserPermissions' cacheHit field and its two branches are now dead code.
issues.zh: TestService_getUserPermissions 的 cacheHit 欄位與兩個分支已成死碼

open_questions.text: Does authlib's cache.NewLocalCache have an entry-count limit? Does the CleanupInterval: 10 * time.Minute setting mean a denial entry that expires after 30 seconds could linger in memory for up to 10 minutes?
open_questions.zh: authlib 的 cache.NewLocalCache 有沒有條目數上限？rbac.go:88 設定的 CleanupInterval: 10 * time.Minute 是否代表 30 秒就過期的 denial 條目最長會在記憶體中滯留 10 分鐘？

open_questions.text: After the in-proc client drops its client-side result cache (switching to NoopCache), is the single-binary Grafana's authorizer hot-path latency still within budget?
open_questions.zh: in-proc client 拿掉 client-side 結果快取（改用 NoopCache）之後，單一 binary 的 Grafana 在 authorizer 熱路徑上的延遲是否仍在預算內？

open_questions.text: Is the denial cache expected to be invalidated when permissions change, or is the 30-second shortCacheTTL the entire contract?
open_questions.zh: denial cache 預期要在權限異動時被失效，還是 30 秒的 shortCacheTTL 就是完整的契約？
